## Key projects

- NURBS-Python (geomdl): https://onurraufbingol.com/projects/nurbs-python — object-oriented B-spline and NURBS library in Python ([GitHub](https://github.com/orbingol/NURBS-Python))
- NVIDIA Omniverse: https://onurraufbingol.com/projects/omniverse — digital twin and robotics simulation demos
- AiToS: https://onurraufbingol.com/projects/aitos — experimental ATS-style resume analyzer ([GitHub](https://github.com/orbingol/aitos))
- Soju Platform: https://onurraufbingol.com/projects/soju-platform — experimental Korean learning platform ([GitHub](https://github.com/orbingol/soju-platform))
